executedCoverage: same-identity changed-content conflict in the Akka application boundary
actor termination and same-system journal replay
Temporal worker shutdown and replacement-worker resume
unknown provider completion requiring observation before retry
version 1 and version 2 application schema acceptance
two concurrent child lifecycles with cancellation and completion
limitations: Akka used its documented non-durable in-memory journal; no CLR or host process crash was proved.
Temporal used the official local dev server with in-memory persistence; no Temporal server crash or restart was proved.
The 250 ms idle interval tests resumption after worker or actor absence, not calendar-scale downtime.
No PostgreSQL adapter, transaction semantics, backup restore, failover, migration, or production topology was exercised.
No external provider call was made; neither runtime received credit for atomic external effects.
Temporal workflow-ID rejection does not compare duplicate payload bytes; content conflicts still need an application receipt.
The lifecycle harness is C# because both SDKs document C# first; the separate F# project proves direct type and attribute compilation only.
